account.title: Response language
account.subtitle: The language agents answer you in, in every project and session. It is separate from the interface language: changing one never changes the other. In a session you can still pin another language just for it, from the session bar.
account.label: Agents' response language
account.otherHint: E.g. pt-PT, es-MX, fr-CA. The API refuses a code that is not a language.
account.error: Could not save the response language
account.loadError: Could not read the response language.
account.detectedNote: Language detected from your messages and confirmed by you: {{idioma}}.
account.notYetApplied: Not sent to agents yet: the language is saved and shown now, and starts applying to answers once the per-turn guidance ships.

origin.sessao: pinned by you in this session
origin.conta: chosen by you on the Account page
origin.detectado: detected from your messages and confirmed by you
origin.interface: the interface language, because nothing was chosen or detected yet
